text:
alex chen: Hey, heads-up — I just opened a docs PR to update the Optimize Toolkit snippets (batching/prefetch/quant). The Go SDK example for KV-prefetch is still the old API and our CI doc link is 404. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421

maria ramos: Thanks @alex — linking the PR. I can take the snippet conversion. Which variant should we show: `Batcher` or `ContinuousBatcher`?

alex chen: Prefer `ContinuousBatcher` for the example, it's the high-level recommended pattern for low-latency apps. Also we should call out the quant profile suggestion for short sequences.

samir patel: quick note: CI failure is due to the external gist URL used in the sample; replace with internal snippet path `/examples/optimize/kv-prefetch/go/main.go` .

katie-ux: UX ask: can we include a tiny before/after perf table? 2 rows, showing tokens/sec for legacy vs prefetch+continuous. keeps people from guessing.

maria ramos: ack. i'll add a minimal table and an inline command to run the microbench:
```
go run ./examples/optimize/kv-prefetch/go --profile shortseq --batcher continuous
```

maria ramos: proposed Go snippet (short):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
cb := optimize.NewContinuousBatcher(client, optimize.WithKVPrefetch())
resp := cb.Generate(ctx, "Summarize: ...", optimize.WithQuantProfile("shortseq"))
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

alex chen: looks good. can you also add a short note about fallbacks: if prefetch misses, we still serve but with ~1.8x latency.

samir patel: added a comment in PR suggesting `// fallback: single-request path when cache miss` + unit test link.

ci-bot: build docs-checks #421 passed — link: https://ci.redwood.internal/421/checks/7 :white_check_mark:

katie-ux: tiny wording nit: change "KV-prefetch" → "KV prefetch (optional)" in the heading so it reads less like a requirement.

maria ramos: done, pushed. also updated the internal example path and fixed the broken link.

alex chen: awesome. last ask — add a short blurb for Dedicated deployments about pinning quant profiles in ded config.

maria ramos: added a 1-paragraph note and a crosslink to the Dedicated docs. PTAL.

alex chen: approving now. thanks y'all :tada:

samir patel: merging after CI completes.

ci-bot: merge complete. PR #421 merged by samir patel at 1711142960
